title: Blank-Dependent Register Action
statement: Let $r$ be a work-tape index, let $d_E,d_B$ be states, and let $rd$ be either a Boolean symbol or blank. If $rd$ is blank, the selected action writes nothing on tape $r$, moves that tape's head one cell left, and enters $d_E$; if $rd$ is a Boolean symbol, it writes nothing on tape $r$, moves that head one cell left, and enters $d_B$.
caveat: The referenced register-action construction is not included in the supplied definitions, so its tape, input-head, and output behavior cannot be fully confirmed.
